cards.headline: The warning moved. The medicines did not change.
cards.body: Same products, same contraindications. Only the wording on the label changed.

cards.headline: A low headline price often has a condition attached.
cards.body: The tracker shows each listed price over time. Check the condition next to it, and quote the date.

cards.headline: A therapist provides talk therapy. A psychiatrist can prescribe.
cards.body: Many people benefit from talk therapy alone, some from medication, and many from both together.

cards.headline: A clinician cannot screen for what is not written down.
cards.body: List everything: prescription drugs, over-the-counter products, supplements and anything recreational.

cards.headline: Published price, times the months you choose.
cards.body: The cost calculator does not estimate, average or add anything. Regular prices sit in their own column.

cards.headline: The Norwood scale is a 7-stage map of male pattern hair loss.
cards.body: It usually moves along two fronts: a receding hairline at the temples and thinning at the crown, which eventually meet.

cards.headline: TRT is a monitored treatment.
cards.body: Baseline labs confirm the diagnosis, and follow-up labs keep it safe and dialed in.
